stemMarkdown: A thief driving at 57 km/h gets a head start of 1.5 hours. A police car then sets off along the same road at 75 km/h. How many hours does the police car take to catch the thief? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In 1.5 hours the thief covers $57 \times 1.5 = 85.5$ km. The police close that gap at $75 - 57 = 18$ km/h, taking $\dfrac{85.5}{18} = 4.75$ hours.
